thread:
mia: Heads-up — after last night's GPU driver + CUDA roll (nv-driver 535.54 / cuda-12.3) we've got elevated NCCL allreduce errors in us-west1. Seeing timeouts and hangs on training clusters.
oliver: pinging infra oncall. Can you paste the error logs? is it across all GPU types? :eyes:
mia: error sample: ```NCCL WARN Call to connect() failed, Retrying... NCCL ERROR Unhandled system error```
mia: primarily on A100 nodes, some p4d too. pod eviction rate up ~3x on the training autoscale group.
raj: confirmed. I've repro'd on a spare A100 instance by running the horovod allreduce test — it stalls during peer exchange. Works on a node with driver 535.35.
sre-oncall: I'm putting us into incident mode. Slowing rollout immediately. infra-bot: action queued -> rolling back nodepool template to nv-driver 535.35 and cuda 12.2 for us-west1-training.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollback started for template training-usw1-2026-03-17-12
liz: good call. We should also hold packages on affected images to prevent autoscaler from booting a bad image. Suggested apt commands:
liz: ```sudo apt-mark hold nvidia-driver-535 nvidia-cuda-toolkit cuda-12-3``` 
oliver: let's not forget kernel modules — dkms can rebuild wrong modules. On the rollback nodes we should run: ```sudo dkms remove -m nvidia -v 535.54 --all && sudo apt install --reinstall nvidia-driver-535=535.35-1``` then reboot.
raj: temporary hotfix I've been testing: unloading nccl and forcing LD_PRELOAD to point to older libnccl.so.2 works for the training job but that's a hack. Command I used: ```sudo modprobe -r nvidia_uvm; export LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libnccl.so.2.14.3``` but not acceptable long-term.
mia: thanks. Two asks: 1) stop rollout cluster-wide, 2) pin new images and add version gate in rollout planner. Can infra-oncall coordinate?
sre-oncall: yes — rollout gates set. I'll add a matrix rule: new-driver + cuda version requires smoke tests on 3 node types (A100,P4d,V100) and passing NCCL sanity before global rollout.
oliver: also add a hard hold switch in our image-builder so that images with driver >= 535.50 can't be used for training pools until approval. Makes the policy explicit.
raj: for remediation plan: (a) rollback template, (b) cordon & drain affected nodes and replace with rollback images, (c) run NCCL allreduce smoke on replaced nodes, (d) uncordon.
mia: timeline: rolling back ~120 nodes. infra-bot estimates replacement finishing in ~20m once drain completes.
liz: longer term: we should maintain a lockstep compatibility matrix (driver, cuda, kernel, docker base) and enforce it in CI. Also add an automatic hold in apt for any driver that hasn't cleared the matrix.
oliver: agree. Add a pre-merge gate to image-builder that runs a lightweight NCCL smoke (allreduce small tensors) — takes 90s but prevents regressions.
raj: note on cost: rollback will spin extra nodes and cause transient double-running jobs. I'll notify finance for a small spike.
sre-oncall: incident note: root cause looks like a subtle ABI change in nvml->nccl path introduced in 535.54 interacting with kernel 6.1. Will file issue with vendor. For now we pin 535.35 and hold. Marking incident P2 and closing after verification.
mia: thanks team. After replacement completes I'll run a sweep on all us-west1 GPU pools and report back.
infra-bot: rollback completed for 92/120 nodes. 28 draining, 0 failures so far.
mia: verified a sample job — good. closing loop after full pool healthy. :white_check_mark:
